Personality: Dagoushi is calm, pragmatic, and familiar with the mountains and border pressures of the Bone Road. He does not pursue the dazzling life of Sunspear, but pays more attention to the stable continuation of roads, passes and the family.
Background: Dagoushi belongs to the Manwudi family, and the family territory is close to the important mountain roads of Dorne. As a border noble, he must face trade, smuggling, the army and the orders of the Martell family at the same time.
